summary.text: Donald Mastronardi is the Republican candidate for Connecticut House of Representatives District 142 in the November 3, 2026 general election, against incumbent Lucy Dathan (D).
A restaurant owner who lives in New Canaan, he was also the Republican nominee for the seat in 2022, when Dathan won.

paragraphs.text: Donald Mastronardi was born in Cortland, New York, and earned a bachelor's degree from Ithaca College in 1998.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he graduated with an accounting degree, then worked as a financial analyst at AIG Asset Management, Bristol Myers Squibb and Daymon Worldwide Marketing.
He said that in 2015 he and his wife took over the Dry Dock Bar & Grille in Norwalk, and that the business later added two more locations and employs more than 45 people.
Mastronardi ran for District 142 in 2022 as the Republican and Independent Party of Connecticut nominee and lost to incumbent Lucy Dathan, 40.2 percent to 59.8 percent.
In the 2022 survey, he listed his campaign messages as cutting taxes, eliminating waste and inefficiency in the government budget, acting as an independent voice, and term limits.
He also said he would like to serve on the Finance/Bonding/Revenue, Higher Education & Employment, or Labor and Public Employees committees.
